meta.description: Curated DoD policy and funding watch profiles. Preserved across Congress.gov sync runs.

bills.title: National Defense Authorization Act oversight track
bills.sponsor: House and Senate Armed Services leadership
bills.cosponsors: To be synced from official bill records
bills.committeeReferral: House Armed Services; Senate Armed Services
bills.plainSummary: Annual defense policy package that can authorize programs, procurement authorities, reporting requirements, and implementation rules affecting the Department of Defense and its contractors.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Watch for acquisition reform language, production scaling authorities, contractor reporting requirements, and incentive structures for delivery speed or cost control.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Track amendments that condition awards, milestone payments, award fees, or executive bonuses on performance, cybersecurity, or domestic sourcing.
bills.nextAction: Monitor subcommittee markups, amendment text, manager packages, and committee reports for contractor-facing provisions.

bills.title: Department of Defense appropriations and spending directives
bills.cosponsors: Not applicable for committee bill profile
bills.committeeReferral: House Appropriations - Defense; Senate Appropriations - Defense
bills.plainSummary: Tracks actual spending levels, earmarks, program increases or cuts, and explanatory report language that directs how DoD funds flow to programs and vendors.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Flag plus-ups, rescissions, reprogramming limits, and report directives that affect prime contractors, subcontractors, and grant recipients.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for restrictions on using funds for certain vendors, foreign sourcing, consulting contracts, or incentive compensation.
bills.nextAction: Compare bill tables and explanatory statements against DoD budget justification books to identify winners, losers, and constraints.

bills.title: Consolidated, minibus, or omnibus packages carrying defense funding
bills.cosponsors: Leadership and authorizing committee members as riders attach

voteCounts.house: Depends on vehicle — sync from Congress.gov
voteCounts.senate: Depends on vehicle — sync from Congress.gov

bills.plainSummary: Tracks large appropriations vehicles that bundle Defense, MilCon, and related accounts when standalone defense bills are delayed or merged.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Identify which division or title carries DoD topline, anomalies, and report language affecting contractor cash flow timing.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for policy riders that restrict contract types, sourcing, or reimbursement outside the defense appropriations subcommittee process.
bills.nextAction: When a consolidated bill drops, map division structure and compare defense title to standalone House and Senate defense bills.

bills.title: Continuing resolution and short-term defense funding rates
bills.plainSummary: Monitors stopgap funding that holds DoD spending at prior-year rates, includes anomalies, and can delay new starts affecting contractors and program offices.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Flag anomaly lists that accelerate or block specific programs, contract awards, and production lines.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Track riders that extend or block regulatory effective dates affecting defense contractors.
bills.nextAction: Compare CR text to final defense appropriations to spot programs trapped at continuing rates.

bills.title: Supplemental defense and emergency appropriations
bills.plainSummary: Tracks emergency or supplemental packages for readiness, munitions replenishment, Ukraine or allied support, and other surge funding outside the base budget.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Identify contract vehicles, FMS lines, and production funding tied to supplemental tables and report language.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for waiver authorities, accelerated acquisition, and contractor accountability riders in emergency packages.
bills.nextAction: Monitor leadership statements and committee releases for standalone vs. bundled supplemental vehicles.

bills.title: Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and related infrastructure funding
bills.cosponsors: Regional delegations with bases and shipyards
bills.committeeReferral: House Appropriations - MilCon-VA; Senate Appropriations - MilCon-VA
bills.plainSummary: Covers military construction accounts that fund facilities, shipyard infrastructure, and installation projects that enable defense production and basing.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Track MILCON line items and report direction for shipyards, depots, and test ranges tied to contractor workload.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Monitor Davis-Bacon, domestic content, and environmental riders affecting construction contractors.
bills.nextAction: Compare MilCon tables to Navy and Air Force unfunded requirements lists for industrial-base facilities.

bills.billNumber: FY2026 Energy and Water / NNSA watch
bills.title: National Nuclear Security Administration and weapons complex funding
bills.committeeReferral: House Appropriations - Energy and Water; Senate Appropriations - Energy and Water
bills.plainSummary: Tracks DOE/NNSA appropriations for warheads, modernization, and the defense nuclear industrial base—often excluded from DoD title but critical to defense contractors.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Flag warhead life-extension programs, pit production, and site modernization contracts in NNSA accounts.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Watch safety, security, and performance accountability language affecting management and operations contractors.
bills.nextAction: Cross-walk Energy-Water bill and report with NNSA budget request and NDAA nuclear provisions.

bills.billNumber: Defense Production Act and industrial base watch
bills.title: Defense Production Act authorities, Title III, and supply-chain funding
bills.sponsor: Armed Services and industrial policy members
bills.cosponsors: To be synced when bill text is introduced
bills.committeeReferral: House Armed Services; Senate Armed Services; relevant appropriations panels
bills.plainSummary: Monitors DPA reauthorizations, industrial-base grants, and contracting tools used to scale critical minerals, microelectronics, and munitions suppliers.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Track loan, grant, and purchase commitments that flow to primes and tier-2/3 suppliers outside traditional program lines.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for domestic preference, reporting, and clawback terms on DPA-funded awards.
bills.nextAction: Scan NDAA and appropriations report language for DPA expansions and industrial-base account plus-ups.

bills.billNumber: Security assistance and FMS funding watch
bills.title: Foreign military sales, security assistance, and allied replenishment funding
bills.sponsor: Foreign Affairs, Armed Services, and Appropriations members
bills.cosponsors: To be synced from official bill records
bills.committeeReferral: House Foreign Affairs; Senate Foreign Relations; State-Foreign Operations appropriators
bills.plainSummary: Tracks appropriations and authorization for FMS, drawdown replenishment, and allied support that backlogs U.S. defense production and contractor delivery schedules.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Identify appropriations that refill stocks, fund co-production, or accelerate lines tied to foreign demand.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Monitor export controls, end-use monitoring, and contractor eligibility restrictions in assistance packages.
bills.nextAction: Link SFOPS and defense supplemental tables to prime contractor order backlogs and lead times.

bills.title: Defense contractor cybersecurity and CMMC implementation
bills.sponsor: Armed Services and Homeland Security oversight members
bills.cosponsors: To be synced when bill text is introduced
bills.committeeReferral: House Armed Services; Senate Armed Services; House Homeland Security; Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
bills.plainSummary: Focuses on cyber requirements for companies that receive DoD contracts, including certification timing, incident reporting, audit burden, and small-business compliance costs.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Track whether compliance costs are reimbursable, whether certification becomes a condition of award, and how primes must police subcontractors.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for penalty language, safe harbors, audit relief, or certification grace periods that change contractor incentives.
bills.nextAction: Monitor hearings, NDAA amendments, and acquisition-policy riders that reference CMMC, DFARS cyber clauses, or defense industrial base incidents.

bills.billNumber: Naval and shipbuilding industrial base watch
bills.title: Shipbuilding, submarine production, and supplier-base funding
bills.committeeReferral: Armed Services seapower panels; Appropriations defense panels
bills.plainSummary: Tracks congressional direction for Navy shipbuilding, submarine production capacity, supplier development, workforce support, and multi-year procurement authorities.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Identify funds targeted to shipyards, component suppliers, workforce pipelines, and production bottlenecks across the maritime defense base.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for delivery incentives, penalty clauses, domestic-content requirements, and workforce grant conditions.
bills.nextAction: Track seapower markup language, appropriations tables, and committee report directions tied to production capacity or schedule slippage.

bills.title: Munitions procurement, surge capacity, and replenishment authorities
bills.sponsor: Readiness, tactical air, land forces, and appropriations members
bills.cosponsors: Members focused on defense industrial capacity
bills.committeeReferral: House Armed Services; Senate Armed Services; Defense Appropriations
bills.plainSummary: Tracks legislation and report language that expands production lines, replenishes inventories, or creates flexible contracting tools for missiles, artillery, and other munitions.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Watch for advance procurement, multi-year buys, Defense Production Act usage, facility modernization grants, and supplier diversification.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Monitor cost-sharing, milestone incentives, reporting requirements, and restrictions on sole-source production expansions.
bills.nextAction: Compare authorization and appropriations language for production-rate assumptions, funding gaps, and contractor deliverables.

bills.billNumber: Contractor compensation and bonus guardrails watch
bills.title: Defense contractor bonus, award-fee, and executive-compensation restrictions
bills.sponsor: Oversight, Armed Services, and appropriations members
bills.cosponsors: To be synced when bill text is introduced
bills.committeeReferral: House Oversight; Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs; Armed Services committees
bills.plainSummary: Focuses on proposals that would limit reimbursement, award fees, bonuses, or executive compensation for defense contractors tied to poor performance, overruns, or compliance failures.
bills.fundingContractSignal: Flag provisions that make compensation unallowable, claw back fees, or condition future awards on delivery and compliance metrics.
bills.regulationBonusWatch: Primary watch item: congressional efforts to reshape contractor bonuses, award fees, and executive-pay reimbursement rules.
bills.nextAction: Monitor watchdog reports, hearing transcripts, and amendments responding to cost overruns or contract-performance failures.
